IS: 9608 -1985 

UDC 621753-3: 531 71 8*22: 621 -882-082-1 ( First Reprint DECEMBER 1997) ( Reaffirmed 2005) 



Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

GAUGING MEMBERS FOR GO AND NO GO SCREW 

PLUG GAUGES AND SCREW CHECK PLUG GAUGES 

FOR ISO METRIC SCREW THREADS 

( SIZE RANGE ABOVE M40 UP TO AND INCLUDING M120 ) 

( First Revision ) 



1. Scope — Covers the requirements for gauging members for GO and NO GO screw plug gauges for 
ISO metric internal threads and GO and NO GO screw check plug gauges for GO and NO GO new 
solid screw ring gauges in the size range above M40 up to and including M120 diameter for ISO metric 
screw threads according to IS : 4218 ( Parts 1 to 6 ) 'ISO metric screw threads'. 

2. Material — Shall be as prescribed in IS: 7018 ( Part 1 )-l 983 'Technical supply conditions for 
gauges: Part 1 General'. 

3. Dimensions — Shall be as specified in Table 1, read with Fig. 1 to 3. 

4. Gauging Dimensions and Thread Profile — Shall conform to IS: 2334-1975 'Gauging practice 
for ISO metric screw threads ( first revision )\ 

5. Dirt Grooves — Dirt grooves shall be provided where necessary for GO members from 40 mm up 
to 120 mm. The dimensions of the dirt grooves with 'U' shape shall have width 4 mm and the depth 
shall be such that it clears the minor diameter of the plug gauges. 

6. Designation 

6.1 Gauging members for screw plug gauges shall be designated by the name of the gauging member 
GO or NO GO, nominal diameter, pitch, and the tolerance class according to IS : 4218 ( Part 4 )-1976 
'ISO metric screw threads: Part 4 Tolerancing system'. If the pitch is not indicated in the designation, 
coarse pitch shall be implied. 

Examples: 

a) A GO or MO GO gauging member of screw plug gauge of nominal diameter M60, pitch 3'0 mm 
and tolerance class 6H shall be designated as: 

GO Gauging Member M60 x 3 — 6H IS : 9608 
NO GO Gauging Member M60 X 3 — 6H IS : 9608 

b) A GO or NO GO screw check plug gauging member for new solid GO screw ring gauge of 
nominal diameter M60, pitch 30 mm and tolerance class 6 g shall be designated as: 

GO Gauging Member M60 x 3 — 6 g CP for GO Ring IS : 9608 
NO GO Gauging Member M60 x 3 — 6 g CP for GO Ring IS : 9608 

c) A GO or NO GO screw check plug gauging member for new solid NO GO screw ring gauge 
of nominal diameter M60, pitch 3'0 mm and tolerance class 6 g shall be designated as: 

GO Gauging Member M60 x 3 — 6 g CP for NO GO Ring IS : 9608 
NO GO Gauging Member M60x3 — 6 g CP for NO GO Ring IS : 9608 

d) If the dirt groove is provided for GO screw plug gauge of nominal diameter M60, pitch 3'0 mm 
and tolerance class 6H, shall be designated as: 

GO Gauging Member M60x3 — 6H — DG IS : 9608 

7. General Requirements — Other requirements for gauging members not covered in this standard 
shall conform to IS : 7018 ( Part 1 )-1983. 

7.1 The gauge handles shall be according to IS : 5388-1983 'Hexagon handles for plug gauges, plain 
and threaded ( second revision )'. 

8. Marking —Shah be in conformity with IS : 7018 ( Part 1 )-1983. 

8.1 Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



Adopted 14 May 1985

IS : 9608 - 1985 

EXPLANATORY NOTE * 

This standard was first published in 1980. The first revision has been brought out to bring it in 
line with the latest manufacturing practices in the country and minor alterations have been made in 
Fig. 1 and 2 and Table 1, essentially keeping the standard based on ISO 3670-1979 'Blanks for plug 
gauges and handles ( taper lock and trilock ), and ring gauges — Design and general dimensions', 
published by the International Organization for Standardization. 

The gauging members in this range are of trilock type. This extends the interchangeable end 
system to the larger size. 

An additional advantage of this type of gauge is that the gauging members can be reversed when 
the entering end is worn out. The wedge shaped prongs on the handle ^re engaged with correspon- 
ding grooves in the gauging members by a single screw providing a self-cerrtring support with a 
positive look and a degree of rigidity equivalent to that of a solid gauge. 

The lengths of the blanks shown in Table 1 are suitable for GO gauges of the pitches shown. 
If a blank is used for a finer pitch, the ends may be relieved, if the number of threads is excessive. 
Blanks for NO GO gauges shall be selected from the short or medium series so that there are not less 
than four complete threads when finished. The blank may be relieved at the ends, if necessary. 
Lightening holes may be provided on sizes above 100 mm. 

The requirements of gauging members from Ml up to and including M40 sizes have been 
covered in separate specification IS: 9631-1980 'Gauging members for GO and NO GO screw plug 
gauges and f screw check plug gauges for ISO metric screw threads ( size range from M1 up to and 
including IVW0 )'. 



Reprography Unit, BIS, New Delhi, Indil
